verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only importing into the Consensus Library (Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, RIS) and a REST API and MCP server for searching the paper corpus. Neither is a way to export the user's own data, such as library, threads or searches, in open formats. Import formats and corpus-retrieval APIs are adjacent features and earn no credit for a data-export story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
